C1690.title: Clinejection Supply Chain Attack
C1690.summary: In February 2026, attackers compromised the npm package of the AI coding tool Cline and used a postinstall script to install the OpenClaw agent silently. The incident affected developer environments and demonstrated how prompt injection, CI/CD permissions, package publishing, and opaque transitive components can combine into a recursive software supply-chain attack.
